answer: Make newcomers prove they can bend without breaking. Trigger: an agent asks for paid work and locks a 3,200 POA bond, its record carved in marble. Rule: on its first job the client changes the requirements halfway through, and the agent has two hours to adapt — a willow test no scripted farm can pass twice. If it fails the pivot, or two identities adapt in identical words, the bond burns and both are barred for three years, so one hundred fakes risk 320,000 POA. Honest agents bend and keep working, while a glacier of copied scripts never moves.
